title: Distribution Line Coordinator
description:
Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is seeking a Distribution Line Coordinator in the Muncie, IN area for a top utility and energy company. This position offers excellent benefits, including health insurance, 401(k), and paid time off.
Job Summary
The Distribution Line Coordinator plays a key role in supporting power line crews by ensuring they have the proper tools, equipment, and training to do their jobs safely and effectively. This position also handles customer concerns, inspects and tests equipment, and supports crews during outages or emergencies.
Responsibilities

  • Assist with job preparation by coordinating with stores, crews, and supervisors to make sure the right tools and equipment are ready.
  • Support training needs by coordinating with trainers and conducting distribution line training when required.
  • Inspect and test tools and equipment used for power line work.
  • Promote and enforce the company’s safety and health programs, ensuring crews follow safety practices.
  • Assist line crews on job sites as needed, including work area protection and ground worker support.
  • Support service restoration during outages and take on other duties as assigned.
Requirements
  • High School diploma or GED required.
  • At least 5 years of experience in distribution line work, distribution engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of distribution operations and activities.

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is seeking a Construction Project Manager to join our team near Anderson, SC. This Direct Hire opportunity offers a competitive compensation package along with excellent benefits, including health insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.
 
Position Summary:
The Project Manager will work closely with the Project Management Office (PMO) to define, develop, and implement project management methods, procedures, and best practices. This role ensures that all procedures are applied effectively across projects while maintaining quality, financial, and schedule targets.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with the PMO to define methods, procedures, and best practices and ensure compliance across projects.
  • Develop project scope in partnership with technical and sales teams, defining responsibilities and all other stakeholders. Utilize standard Project Management tools to manage projects efficiently.
  • Identify and secure resources to meet project objectives. Work with functional leaders to create the project organizational resource chart and a RACI matrix to clarify roles and responsibilities.

  • Evaluate alternative delivery methods to improve project outcomes and establish clear processes between functional areas.
  • Escalate issues promptly to ensure timely resolution, monitor team schedules, and coordinate activities along the critical path. Conduct effective meetings and presentations with stakeholders.
  • Implement project tracking, reporting, and KPIs to monitor quality, schedule, and cost. Maintain meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups.
  • Promote a culture of safety across all projects, hosting periodic safety meetings to prioritize safety at every stage.
Minimum Qualifications:
  • 3–5 years of project management experience; critical infrastructure experience (UPS, thermal, battery, monitoring) is a plus
  • Knowledge of construction, electrical, and mechanical contracting
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong customer service and project management skills
  • Detail-oriented with excellent organizational, analytical, and interpersonal abilities
  • Ability to multi-task and thrive in a fast-paced environment
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Knowledge of engineering, manufacturing processes, data center infrastructure, and commissioning processes

title: Machining Manufacturing Engineer
description:

  • Maintain plant and line layout.
  • Develop and update PFMEA.
  • Work closely with quality to resolve manufacturing issues and develop control plans.
  • Write work instructions.
  • Participate in the changeover process.
  • Identify opportunities to speed up changeover processes.
  • Maintain a high level of organization.
  • Work with the team to establish 5S criteria for cells.

  • All other duties as assigned.

Qualifications / Experience / Education

  • Ability to communicate effectively with co-workers.
  • Experience with SolidWorks, Solid Edge, and AutoCAD.
  • Experience in Hot and Cold Forging.
  • Strong understanding of Milling and Lathe operations and programming.
  • Flow Forming experience is a plus.
  • Understanding of takt time and capacity planning.
  • Understanding of automation (Fanuc, Allen Bradley, Siemens, ASE).
  • Understanding of 5S and Lean manufacturing principles.
  • Must be innovative, dedicated to self-improvement, and willing to try new things.

title: Project Manager - Federal Grant and Loan Application Support
description:
Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is seeking a Project Manager to work for a top utility and energy company in the Columbus, OH area. This position offers a variety of great benefits, including health insurance, 401(k), and paid time off.
 
Job Summary: The detail-oriented and proactive Project Manager will assist in the federal grant and loan application submission efforts. The ideal candidate will support the Grant Submittal Manager and the LPO Contract Manager in various project management activities.   • Support LPO Contract Manager: Provide administrative and project support to the Federal Loan Manager in preparing and submitting Federal Loan applications.
  
Requirements: 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, Project Management or related field of study.
  • 3 years of qualified experience as a Project Manager or demonstrated competencies, knowledge, and skillset through achieved results in a shorter timeline.
  • Valid state driver's license is required.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Proficiency in project management software and tools.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
